criterion_text: For supported Claude CLI versions, querying a concrete Nession Session returns accurate on-demand PID-matched `busy|waiting|idle`, `waiting_for` and conversation ID when supplied; unsupported CLI, ambiguous process or missing identity answers unknown/unavailable instead of a guessed state, without requiring a new state-tracking Hook.

verifiers.summary: the CLI answer parser, its non-verified observations and the Claude process identity rule are pinned in source; the live verifier drives the real CLI path

evidence.value: the captured `agents --json` shape (2.1.326 fixture, not an admission gate) parsed into typed busy/waiting/idle and background states; unknown values survived verbatim, a missing sessionId stayed null, an unlisted version was interpreted by its answer, an older CLI without the command was unsupported, and absent/unsupported/cannot-observe were each distinct and never reported as idle; the executable/argv0/script identity rule accepts the real CLI shapes and rejects a Session adapter path or an argument that merely contains "claude"

verifiers.summary: a real Claude CLI 2.1.312 (Claude Code) in one named Session produced verified PID-matched idle, busy and waiting observations with the exact conversation id; a busy Session refused redirect without a second writer

evidence.value: exact SHA 4154866259139b6b3e9c4c1ef32ef9635b41fa22: CLI 2.1.312 (resolved 2.1.312 (Claude Code)); before launch the named Session answered process=not_running, activity=unknown, conversation_id=null, observation=verified
the real CLI answered process=running, activity=idle, observation=verified with the exact launched conversation id 02650d81-7d8e-4e6e-a1df-263376b7a3c6; the Agent bound its PID to this Session
during a live Bash turn the same Session answered activity=busy with observation=verified and the same conversation id

enter new while that live turn was busy answered status=refused and created no second transcript writer: Claude is not verifiably idle; refusing to redirect it or create a concurrent transcript writer
at a live AskUserQuestion prompt the same Session answered activity=waiting, waiting_for=`input needed`, observation=verified and the same conversation id
